ghost_wolves.name: Ghost Wolves
ghost_wolves.desc: Spectral wolves hunt the nearest enemy and bite. Bites cause bleeding.

count.name: Pack size
count.hint: One more wolf joins the hunt

power.name: Bite power
power.hint: Each bite hits harder, and bleed grows with it

duration.name: Rend
duration.hint: Bleed drains {old} → {new} of a bite every second, for {bleedSec}s

raven_flock.name: Raven Flock
raven_flock.desc: Ravens perch by you, then swoop on foes they spot, peck, and fly back.

count.name: Flock size
count.hint: One more raven joins the flock

range.name: Watch
range.hint: Ravens spot foes {old} → {new} out from you

speed.name: Wingbeat
speed.hint: Ravens swoop {upct} more often and fly faster

spirit_bolts.name: Spirit Bolts
spirit_bolts.desc: Homing spirit orbs seek out the nearest enemies.

count.name: Bolt count
count.hint: One more bolt in every volley

speed.name: Swiftness
speed.hint: Bolts fly {upct} faster, curve tighter and fire {rate} sooner

pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.hint: Each bolt passes through one more foe

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.desc: Lightning strikes the nearest enemy and jumps between foes.

chains.name: Chains
chains.hint: Lightning jumps to one more foe

power.name: Power
power.hint: Each strike hits harder (the first foe takes 1.5x)

area.name: Arc
area.hint: Each jump reaches {old} → {new} away and loses less power (5% → 0% per jump at full Arc)

holy_orbit.name: Holy Orbit
holy_orbit.desc: Holy orbs circle you and burn anything they touch.

count.name: Orb count
count.hint: One more candle light circles you

radius.name: Orbit size
radius.hint: Ring reaches {old} → {new} out; it pulls in tight when foes press against you

speed.name: Orbit speed
speed.hint: Lights circle {upct} faster and hit the same foe {rate} more often
